docs.title: Metadata Documents
docs.tip: Raw documents in metadata_document (upstream JSON with CR stripped), served at /metadata/Genshin/<locale>/<name>.json. The ETag is the document XXH64.

overrides.title: i18n Overrides
overrides.tip: Manual string overrides in metadata_translation. Each row keeps the original value, so removing one restores it and rebuilds Meta.json. Re-importing upstream re-applies every override automatically.

projection.title: Derived Read Model
projection.tip: Projection status of metadata_object / metadata_object_i18n / metadata_object_layout / metadata_object_ref. These tables only answer filters and lookups — the bytes served still come straight from metadata_document, so rebuilding never changes what the launcher downloads. Any write to a document (re-import or a new translation) marks its kind stale; a full rebuild takes 148 s measured and runs from the command line: dotnet run -c Release --project tools/MetadataImport -- --project

leaves.title: String Workbench
leaves.tip: Flattens the string leaves of one document and compares them against a baseline locale. Saving writes to the override table, patches the document and rebuilds that locale's Meta.json.
leaves.namePlaceholder: Document name, e.g. Weapon or Avatar/10000002
leaves.onlyDiff: Only strings differing from the baseline

dialog.removeBody: Remove the override on {locale}/{name}{pointer}? That string goes back to the original, and the document hash plus Meta.json are rebuilt.
